description: This file defines the SettingsActivity class and its associated ViewModel, managing a UI form for configuring SSH settings such as host, port, username, password, and command template. It handles loading current preferences, validation, saving changes, and secure storage of sensitive data.

classes.name: SettingsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that provides a UI for editing SSH connection settings, integrating with ViewModel and handling user interactions.

classes.name: SettingsViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that manages state related to SSH configuration, including loading, validation, and persistence of preferences and secure password storage.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and binds UI elements and event handlers.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Begins collecting UI state updates to update layout accordingly.

methods.name: onSaveClicked
methods.description: Handles save button click; validates and persists settings.

methods.name: onClearPasswordClicked
methods.description: Clears stored password and UI indication.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets or clears validation error on form fields.

methods.name: addRealtimeValidationHelpers
methods.description: Adds text watchers to validate inputs in real-time.

methods.name: simpleWatcher
methods.description: Returns a TextWatcher that triggers a callback after text changes.

methods.name: markPrefilled
methods.description: Marks initial data as loaded to prevent overwriting UI before first load.

methods.name: clearHostError
methods.description: Clears validation error for host field.

methods.name: clearPortError
methods.description: Clears validation error for port field.

methods.name: clearUsernameError
methods.description: Clears validation error for username field.

methods.name: clearCommandTemplateError
methods.description: Clears validation error for command template field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates inputs and saves SSH configuration and password if provided.

methods.name: clearPassword
methods.description: Removes stored password from secure storage.
